# LUBS5134 Econometrics and LUBS5108 Applied Econometrics {#metrix}
Students are expected to have covered the mathematics and statistics topics listed [here](maths_stats.qmd).
	
In addition, students should be familiar with:
	
- Linear regression.
- Properties of Ordinary Least Squares (OLS).
- Interpretation of regression coefficients.
- Statistical significance.
- Measures of fit.

Please complete the [Statistics & Econometrics Quiz](stats-quiz.qmd) to check your knowledge and identify any gaps that require further study.
	
Recommended Reading:
	
- @Wooldridge2024, appendices: mathematical and statistical foundations.
- @Wooldridge2024, chaps. 1-4: core undergraduate econometrics material.
